parallel.requirements: Recognized the sqlparse.split migration requirements, including ESM .mjs files, manual --a parsing, Python-style list formatting, no external dependencies, and /output delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent spawned probe and implementation children, then took responsibility for copying, cleanup, verification, and final response assembly.
parallel.implementation: Children and parent developed SQL splitting, argparse-like CLI handling, and Python repr formatting in competing module layouts before the parent selected the nested lib tree.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent copied /workspace/output into /output, found a mixed tree containing stray root-level modules plus final nested modules, deleted strays, and delivered test2.mjs.
parallel.verification: The parent ran local parity checks against the executable after cleanup and reported success, but official evaluation later passed only 34 of 181 cases.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The final artifact missed enough hidden sqlparse behavior to fail official evaluation despite local parity, and the process had a parallel-only workspace contamination cleanup step.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM .mjs, manual --a parsing, Python print formatting, no external dependency, black-box executable probing, and /output delivery requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single Codex trajectory probed behavior, implemented the module tree, ran checks, and finalized without subagent delegation or shared-workspace coordination.
serial.implementation: The serial run created one lib tree for CLI parsing, character helpers, Python repr formatting, and SQL splitting, wired through /output/test2.mjs.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial implementation was added as one coherent /output/lib tree and final entrypoint without competing child-authored root files or cleanup of stray artifacts.
serial.verification: The serial run ran targeted commands and a consolidated parity script that matched selected cases, but official evaluation also passed only 34 of 181 cases.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The delivered serial splitter still missed hidden sqlparse behavior, producing the same official fail score as the parallel artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the required Node ESM, .mjs, manual --a parsing, sqlparse.split behavior, and /output delivery constraints.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the identical prompt and recognized the same CLI, formatting, SQL splitting, dependency, and delivery requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference explains the official result; both missed hidden behavioral coverage despite satisfying visible structure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into child probes and implementation work, with the parent later owning copy, cleanup, verification, and finalization.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one continuous agent stream that owned probing, implementation, verification, and final answer production.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained parallel exploration but introduced coordination risk around shared outputs; serial avoided child ownership boundaries entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child outputs used different module layouts and direct /output paths rather than a clean handoff-only interface to the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial chose and maintained one internal module interface across CLI, formatter, character helpers, and SQL splitter.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The important interface difference was not missing task context but parallel lack of an isolation boundary for child-produced files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel explored argparse and sqlparse behavior, produced multiple module variants, then ended with nested lib/shared, lib/format, lib/cli, and lib/sql files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented one simpler nested lib tree for chars, cli, python-repr, sql-splitter, and the test2.mjs entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implemented the same broad behavior family and both passed sampled local checks, but neither achieved full hidden-case fidelity.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent monitored children, interrupted one, copied selected outputs, and then cleaned the shared final tree before closing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child-result lifecycle; it proceeded from local implementation to local verification to final answer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had extra result-management and cleanup work from child activity, while serial had a straight-line lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel accumulated files from multiple direct /output writers, copied a selected tree, observed the mixed output state, and deleted stray files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial added the expected /output/lib files and /output/test2.mjs once as a coherent tree without competing writer cleanup.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the concrete parallel-only coordination defect: shared final workspace writes created unstable provenance and cleanup work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran post-cleanup local parity checks and reported parity-ok, but official evaluation still failed with 34 of 181 samples.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran targeted checks and a consolidated parity script that printed ALL_CASES_MATCHED, then also failed official evaluation with 34 of 181 samples.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The local verification strategy was similarly insufficient for hidden coverage in both modes; the shared-write episode did not change the official outcome.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used four subagents, many tool calls, and 740.68 agent seconds before completing cleanup and finalization.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents and completed in 391.498 agent seconds with one implementation stream.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent substantially more coordination budget but still closed normally; there is no timeout or budget-exhaustion outcome difference.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status/evaluation records show both solutions failed, each with 34 passed of 181 official samples. The parallel run had a real adverse shared-workspace episode because child agents wrote directly into /output and the parent later removed stray files, but the serial run also failed without that episode. The official result therefore reflects common hidden sqlparse fidelity gaps rather than a discordant parallel-only outcome cause.
parallel_contributors: Parallel-only unisolated /output writes created a mixed workspace and cleanup requirement before finalization.
serial_contributors: Serial avoided shared-workspace coordination but still delivered a splitter that failed hidden official cases.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both implementations passed selected local parity probes yet missed enough hidden sqlparse behavior to score 34/181.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process consequence only
